Title: Overlord: The Sacred Kingdom
Actors: Satoshi Hino, Yumi Hara, Masayuki Katô
Plot: Momonga, now known as the Sorcerer King Ains Ooal Gown, rallies the Sorcerer Kingdom and its undead army to join the fight alongside the Sacred Kingdom and the Slane Theocracy in hopes to defeat the Demon Emperor Jaldabaoth.
